name: Built Cybernetics plc
summary: Built Cybernetics plc, headquartered in London and established in 1906, operates across the United Kingdom and Turkey, offering a diverse array of integrated professional design services through its various subsidiaries. Formerly known as Aukett Swanke Group Plc until its renaming in February 2025, the company's activities are structured into key segments including UK Architecture, Torpedo Factory Group, Anders+Kern, ecoDriver, and Continental Europe. Its extensive service portfolio encompasses architectural design, ranging from master planning and interior design to fit-out solutions, primarily delivered under the Aukett Swanke brand. It also provides executive architectural delivery through the Veretec brand, alongside architect of record and project execution stage services. The firm further specializes in energy management, offering energy monitoring software, efficiency consulting, and essential hardware for tracking energy consumption, complemented by comprehensive support and engineering services. Additionally, Built Cybernetics is involved in the distribution and installation of workplace technology, the integration of smart building and AV systems, software development, and the design, supply, and installation of stage technology, engineering, and associated master systems. Non-trading activities also form a part of its operations.
